stock.description: Hi Sun Technology (China) Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It operates through the following segments: Payment and Digital Services, Fintech Services, Platform Operation Services, and Financial Solutions. The Payment and Digital Services segment refer to payment processing. The Fintech Services segment includes micro-lending, supply chain financing, factoring, and credit assessment. The Platform Operation Solution is involved in telecommunication and mobile payment platforms. The Financial Solutions segment pertains to information system consultancy. The company was founded on May 31, 2001 is headquartered in Hong Kong.
